english: Hey! You can't try the shooting range without one of our custom bows. If you want to play, you need to talk to Mina Starling first. She'll get you squared away.
Hey! You looking for a job?
Hey, "tour guide," anything else we should know about these cursed lands before we go rushing in?
Hey, I can handle old ladies. I could take on everyone in town. Well, except maybe the lieutenant and that battleaxe who runs the fighting pit. But anyone else, definitely.
Hey, I didn't ask for this. Why are you yelling at me?
Hey, I need to take this purifier to the Maguuma spring. Can you help?
Hey, I think I found another mineral vein.
Hey, Issormir was worthy of a Great Hunt. We did pretty well.
Hey, check it out! It dropped something.
Hey, come on. They're training devourers. Hurry. You gotta see this.
Hey, could use your help over here. Please. For the ward's sake.
Hey, devourer training is in session. We're down a teacher. Grab a training kit and whip these devourers into shape.
Hey, he's stealing an egg! Gut that sucker!
Hey, if you got the time, keep an eye on our little egg collector. If she gets back in one piece, there'll be griffon omelettes for everyone.
Hey, it wasn't junk when I brought it up here. It was Zee that tinkered them into heaps of scrap.
Hey, keep it down! We're near an Inquest lab.
Hey, let Kukumuru catch that one! How else is he gonna learn?
Hey, look! Some of these crabs are still alive! Good thing I was here, eh?

Hey, no entry. Private event going on. Now beat it!

Hey, there. Did you hear anything?
Hey, these are actually pretty nice! Maybe that cave isn't so bad after all...
Hey, think you could help me out? My Deionizing Arcanoduster can clean this dust up, but I don't want to get mauled by animals in the process.
Hey, this projector thing isn't working again!
Hey, undercover here. Come back when the heat's off.
Hey, watch the dog cracks! He didn't mean anything by that, Allie-girl, I promise.
Hey, weren't you banned from the park? Security!
Hey, what's that strange glow around your armor?
Hey, what's wrong with having a little fun, and forgetting our troubles for awhile?
Hey, you finished that book I loaned you?
Hey, you get a chance to explore later and find anything interesting—exotic plants, ornery beasties—be sure to tell me!
Hey, you look like someone who doesn't mind gettin' a little soot on ya. Eh?
Hey, you look new to this area. You probably want to get a bit more seasoning before heading out this way.
Hey, you look pretty smart. We know everything there is to know about Destiny's Edge. Come prove that you know as much as we do, if you think you can!
Hey, you want to leave? Go ahead. It's my discovery anyway.
Hey, you! Is Darrin still away in Claypool?
Hey, you! Yeah, you! Not from around here, huh? Ever heard of the Ministry of Purity? Interested in a quick history lesson...?
Hey, you. Yeah, you. C'mere, I want to talk to you.
Hey. Lend a hand, would you? We have to get our supplies back before the skritt get spit all over them.
Hey. Newcomer. You here to pitch in, or you plan to just drag us down? What do you say? You a sail, or you an anchor?
Hey. You're zapping my mortar mojo. Take a few steps back, will ya?
Hey. Your toy's got some sass!
